name: Hall's Cornerless Maximum Class
definition: The 299-concept class in $Q_{12}$ obtained from Hall's nonextendable partial shelling of the twelve-dimensional cross-polytope; the exact concepts are the ancillary data cited and replayed by the ample-corners manuscript.
properties: It is maximum of VC dimension three and has no corner. Each one-coordinate contraction is ample of order 232 and has exactly two corners.
